GWM Benchmark: NuScale FSAR Multi-Evidence QA Dataset
	

A multi-evidence, multi-modal QA benchmark for evaluating RAG systems on nuclear regulatory documents. Built from NuScale Final Safety Analysis Report (FSAR) Chapters 01 and 05.
